name: PostgreSQL cluster for sso.example.org (production)
description: PostgreSQL 18 with OpenSSL 3.5, operated by Example Org's database team.
comment: EXAMPLE CBOM, lifecycle stage 'configured'. Example Org's production PostgreSQL cluster, the database Keycloak's int-db interface connects to, recorded by the database team from its own configuration repository. Illustrative values. The server permits the hybrid group X25519MLKEM768 (PostgreSQL 18 ssl_groups, OpenSSL 3.5). The TLS interface names the client end of the connection with peerInterface: Keycloak's int-db interface in the sso-prod configured record, which this record cites by hash. Administration runs through the platform's automation, so there is no administrative listener. PostgreSQL publishes no CBOM, so the interface states 'no-product-document' and names its library here. Conforms to deployment-disclosure v0.3.

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: ssl_groups = 'X25519MLKEM768:X25519'; ssl_min_protocol_version = 'TLSv1.3'; hostssl only in pg_hba.conf. Server certificate RSA-2048 from the internal CA.

references.comment: The configured record of the sso-prod deployment, which holds the client end of the connection this record's TLS interface names with peerInterface.
